name: Benchgen
description: Stream OpenClaw agent traces to Benchgen for observability and training-data capture

enabled.description: Enable Benchgen streaming while the plugin is loaded.

publicKey.description: Benchgen project public key. Falls back to BENCHGEN_PUBLIC_KEY.

secretKey.description: Benchgen project secret key. Falls back to BENCHGEN_SECRET_KEY.

baseUrl.description: Benchgen ingest endpoint. Falls back to BENCHGEN_BASE_URL.

startupTrace.description: Send one trace whenever the plugin starts (including a config hot reload), as proof the credentials and endpoint work. Tagged benchgen-setup. Defaults to true.

debugEvents.description: Log the field names of the first diagnostic event of each type, to diagnose fields that arrive empty. No prompt or tool content is logged. Defaults to false.

enabled.label: Streaming Enabled
enabled.help: Stream agent traces to Benchgen while the plugin is loaded.

publicKey.label: Benchgen Public Key
publicKey.help: Copy from your project settings in the Benchgen dashboard. Falls back to BENCHGEN_PUBLIC_KEY.

secretKey.label: Benchgen Secret Key
secretKey.help: Copy from your project settings in the Benchgen dashboard. Falls back to BENCHGEN_SECRET_KEY.

baseUrl.label: Benchgen Endpoint
baseUrl.help: Your Benchgen endpoint URL. Falls back to BENCHGEN_BASE_URL.

startupTrace.label: Send Startup Trace
startupTrace.help: Sends one trace named benchgen.plugin.connected, tagged benchgen-setup, each time the plugin starts — a config change counts, so you get a fresh verdict right after editing keys. Turn off if frequent restarts make it noisy.
